description: VYBE Music v4.1.8 — Social Video Music Identifier with Continuous Radio, Brand-New Transparent VYBE Update Dialog Logo, Native System Capsule Integration, and Real-Time Cross-Device Admin Push Notifications.
changelog: Instagram & Video Music Identification: Share reels, TikToks, or Shorts into VYBE Music to identify songs and play with 1 tap via clean bottom sheet dialog
Continuous Radio Playback: Play Now automatically queues infinite matching songs so your music never abruptly stops
Transparent VYBE Update Logo: Replaced legacy Google badge with high-visibility transparent VYBE logo without background
Native System Capsule Integration: Cooperates with Android punch-hole capsules (realme Mini Capsule, OnePlus Fluid Cloud, HyperOS) with no in-app collision
Real-Time Cross-Device Push Notifications: Announcements sent by admin to 'All Members' are broadcast instantly across all devices
Automatic Announcement Catch-Up: Offline or asleep devices catch up and display push alerts upon wake or startup
Liquid Glass Navigation Bar: Frosted translucent bottom pill with smooth spring tab glide
Listen Together Beat Sync Precision: Sub-20ms drift synchronization across all paired devices for zero-echo playback
